frozen_baseline.rule: This file normalizes existing approved meaning. It does not create product authority or modify frozen Goldens.

normalization_rules: Use canonical semantic terms for reusable product meaning; keep journey presentation in the Goldens.
One semantic concept has one canonical owner here; journeys may project it but do not redefine it.
Registry/approval status outranks stale status prose inside older spec headers.
Approved contract overlays remain referenced contracts; do not duplicate their full schema into this file.
Implementation/research behavior cannot upgrade itself into product truth.
Unknown or deliberately unselected policy remains explicit.

J05_RECOVERED.classification: recovered review-session evidence; not frozen product-authority replacement

DEC_EXP_LOCK.classification: approved human product decision after frozen Golden baseline; immutable approving commit

DEC_EXP_LOCK_V2.classification: approved human clarification of settlement-lock integration semantics; immutable approving commit

objects.name: Participant
objects.meaning: Durable group-scoped ledger identity for a person participating in a ChopDot group; may exist without a full account and survives later account linking.

objects.name: AccountIdentity
objects.meaning: Account-backed identity context that may enrich a Participant after verified binding without replacing the Participant.

objects.name: Session
objects.meaning: Current authenticated/account entry context. Signing in and joining a group remain separate acts; sign-out does not erase product history.

objects.name: GuestCapability
objects.meaning: Least-authority participant-controlled group-scoped mutation capability for a guest Participant.

objects.name: GroupMembership
objects.meaning: Current access/role relationship between a Participant and Group. Changing access never rewrites historical ledger attribution or other memberships.

objects.name: Invitation
objects.meaning: Invitation context that can survive entry interruptions and, after explicit consent and valid authority, lead to group membership.

objects.name: MoneyV1
objects.meaning: Canonical exact-money partition used for financial conservation: integer minor units plus currency and exponent. Display decimals are not authoritative.

objects.name: OperationIdentity
objects.meaning: Stable logical identity for a potentially effectful operation; possible-effect uncertainty remains bound to the same identity until reconciled.

objects.name: OperationOutcome
objects.meaning: Truth classification for an operation such as pending, verified success, verified no-effect failure, unknown, partial, cancelled or reversed. Domain operations may refine the state vocabulary.

objects.name: Group
objects.meaning: Stable shared workspace identity with display/configuration state, membership and lifecycle. Rename/archive/leave/delete do not silently rewrite ledger truth.

objects.name: Expense
objects.meaning: Recorded shared cost in a Group with exact amount/currency, description, payer, participants/split, date and optional receipt/history.

objects.name: Split
objects.meaning: Beneficiary allocation of an Expense across selected Participants using Equal, Exact or Shares semantics; it contains participant-bound ExpenseAllocation entries whose MoneyV1 amounts conserve the Expense total.

objects.name: ExpenseReview
objects.meaning: A Participant's review state for an Expense, distinct from editing the Expense itself.

objects.name: ExpenseIssue
objects.meaning: Narrowly scoped question/dispute attached to an Expense with reason, optional note and resolution state. Only dependent payment items are blocked.

objects.name: Position
objects.meaning: Derived financial position showing what is owed/owing for a typed PositionScope and one currency, with source lineage. It is read-only product truth derived from underlying records.

objects.name: SettlementScope
objects.meaning: Canonical exact settlement scope: payer, recipient, exact amount, one currency and frozen source lineage selected before authorization. Source membership does not silently widen, but current eligibility must remain valid before execution.

objects.name: PaymentIntent
objects.meaning: Typed settlement lifecycle for an already-existing obligation. Preparing/authorizing a payment is distinct from execution, receipt and closure.

objects.name: PaymentRecord
objects.meaning: Stable user-readable payment record and lifecycle timeline for one payment identity; history is read-only and does not re-execute payment effects.

objects.name: PaymentRequest
objects.meaning: Private request for an exact initiating balance/source scope. Request creation, delivery and payment are separate truths.

objects.name: PaymentDestination
objects.meaning: Saved receiving/payment destination and compatibility-scoped preference. It is not payment authority or a connected signing wallet.

objects.name: ReceivingShare
objects.meaning: Recipient-scoped, deliberate disclosure of receiving details. Prepared/shared/copy states never imply payment receipt or settlement.

objects.name: WalletSession
objects.meaning: Connected execution capability with current account/network context. Connection is not saved destination, public profile, or permission to move arbitrary funds.

objects.name: WalletAction
objects.meaning: Exact action contract received from an owning ChopDot journey through signature, submission, unknown/reconciliation and finality states.

objects.name: QRPayload
objects.meaning: Transport representation only. A QR payload cannot itself join a group, execute payment, disclose raw receiving secrets, create wallet authority or substitute settlement context; the owner journey revalidates it.

objects.name: SpendIntent
objects.meaning: Rail-neutral coordination of value before/during a purchase. Separate economic domain from PaymentIntent; authorization is not spend.

objects.name: SpendEffect
objects.meaning: Proof-backed capture/partial/refund/reversal effect on a SpendIntent lineage. Canonical expense/obligation materialization occurs exactly once from accepted effects.

objects.name: SavingsGroup
objects.meaning: Shared savings coordination context with one exact currency/asset, explicit control/custody model, confirmed Available amount and goal progress.

objects.name: SavingsPosition
objects.meaning: Participant-owned confirmed savings position. Planned/self-reported/pending money does not increase confirmed Available.

objects.name: SavingsOperation
objects.meaning: Exact scoped contribution or withdrawal with actor, group, amount/asset, control model, source version and recoverable outcome.

objects.name: AcceptedEvent
objects.meaning: Accepted durable domain event/history fact used to rebuild projections; replay is side-effect free.

objects.name: DurableOutboxEntry
objects.meaning: Durable delivery companion accepted with the event in one durability boundary; delivery may retry while consumers deduplicate.

objects.name: ActivityItem
objects.meaning: Read-only ChopDot milestone projection derived from accepted canonical domain truth; technical refresh noise is not user activity. The product schema does not mandate a particular event/outbox implementation.

objects.name: AttentionItem
objects.meaning: Derived unresolved user task kept separate from chronology and notification unread state.

objects.name: NotificationDelivery
objects.meaning: Recipient-scoped snapshot/copy with read/unread metadata. Delivery/read state is never underlying domain authority.

objects.name: Insight
objects.meaning: Read-only derived pattern over currently authorized accepted records; exact assets remain separate and incomplete windows suppress misleading comparisons.

objects.name: ImportOperation
objects.meaning: Preview-before-write import of external data into one new Group; no existing-group auto-merge, name-only identity linking or silent money guessing.

objects.name: ExportOperation
objects.meaning: Read/copy-only export bound to exact scope, source snapshot/version, package schema and destination intent; artifact creation is separate from delivery.

objects.name: ExportArtifact
objects.meaning: Portable package preserving stable IDs, money/status semantics and explicit ambiguity while excluding secrets/executable authority.

objects.name: BackupArtifact
objects.meaning: Backup is distinct from the local working copy; it excludes secrets/executable authority and its checksum proves byte integrity only.

objects.name: RestoreOperation
objects.meaning: Preview-before-mutation restore/recovery operation that preserves identity ambiguity and newer current facts and reconciles unknown outcomes before retry.

objects.name: AccountPreferences
objects.meaning: ChopDot profile presentation, notification preference and appearance preference. Draft/preview state is reversible and UI preference is not external/system/payment authority.

objects.name: RecoveryContext
objects.meaning: Shared recovery interaction context preserving the original owner and operation/state identity; recovery coordinates truth but does not own the underlying domain result.

objects.name: ExpenseAllocation
objects.meaning: One beneficiary allocation entry inside an Expense Split, bound to the exact Participant it charges and to MoneyV1.

objects.name: ExpenseReceipt
objects.meaning: Optional receipt attachment/reference associated with one Expense; create/edit may add, replace or remove it without changing Expense identity.

objects.name: ExpenseChangeRecord
objects.meaning: Read-only old→new change projection derived from accepted persisted Expense revisions; it can show important deltas such as participant/share changes without becoming a mutation surface.

objects.name: ExpenseMutationGuard
objects.meaning: Effect-time predicate over attempted Expense mutation current state, proposed post-state, exact unresolved settlement descriptors, Position-derived dependency snapshots and dispute eligibility. Incomplete or stale safety evidence fails closed.

objects.name: GroupRecentItem
objects.meaning: Group-scoped recent-history projection used by Group Home to answer what happened without depending on the later global Activity journey.

objects.name: ExpenseRevision
objects.meaning: Accepted persisted Expense snapshot/revision used to compare prior and current Expense truth without selecting an event-store or database architecture.

objects.name: GroupCloseoutContext
objects.meaning: Approved future whole-group closeout coordination context. It broadens Expense mutation locking to the whole Group, but has no approved user surface and is explicitly outside Gate B construction.

objects.name: PositionScope
objects.meaning: Typed scope for Position: either one participant pair or one Group. Currency remains the Position money partition.

operations.name: Enter / authenticate
rules: Sign-in preserves original destination/invite context.
Sign-in does not join a group or authorize payment.

operations.name: Link Participant to account
rules: Preserve participant_id and historical references.
Binding is staged; mismatch/collision remains unresolved.
Account-only capabilities appear only after durable verified binding.

operations.name: Create Group
rules: Create with minimum necessary decisions; savings remains a separate product path.

operations.name: Create/share invitation
rules: Invitation context and join authority remain distinct from sign-in.

operations.name: Join Group
rules: Explicit consent precedes durable participant membership.

operations.name: Remove member access
rules: Current group owner only under the approved prerequisites.
Removal preserves historical attribution/ledger facts and other memberships.
Unknown save recovers before retry.

operations.name: Create Expense
rules: Common path is amount + description with editable defaults.
No invented common-path review page.
Failed save preserves entered details.
Custom split must conserve the expense total.

operations.name: Edit Expense
rules: Reuse Journey 05 fields and controls with existing values.
Only the expense owner or an authorized role may edit.
After the Journey 06 Save changes path is accepted, reviews current at edit acceptance reset to needs-review-again, including a participant removed by that edit.
An owner edit may answer/correct an issue but cannot itself resolve the reviewer's issue or fabricate agreement.

dependent_state_effects.effect: after accepted persistence, reset reviews current at edit acceptance to needs_review_again and preserve prior review history
open issue remains unresolved until Journey 07 reviewer resolution

operations.name: Delete Expense
rules: Explicit confirmation separate from edit.
Deletion explains/recomputes balance impact.

operations.name: Agree with Expense
rules: Review is distinct from editing.
Looks right resolves the reviewer's review state, not unrelated domain state.

operations.name: Raise Expense Issue
rules: Issue includes reason and optional note.
Only dependent payment items are blocked.

dependent_state_effects.effect: invalidate any prepared intent whose eligibility depends on the changed dispute state; require fresh settlement resolution before execution

operations.name: Resolve / reassess Expense Issue
rules: Journey 07 owns issue resolution status. Owner correction remains Journey 06; a correction does not fabricate reviewer agreement.

dependent_state_effects.effect: invalidate any prepared intent whose eligibility depends on the changed dispute state; require fresh settlement resolution before execution

operations.name: Prepare Settlement
rules: Resolve exact SettlementScope before authorization.
Journey 11 prepares/authorizes; it does not complete.
Freeze exact source lineage before authorization; later unrelated Expenses do not mutate the prepared scope.

operations.name: Authorize PaymentIntent
rules: Approval request is not authorization; only verified result advances authority.
Delegation cannot widen exact scope.

operations.name: Record payer sent claim
rules: Payer sent claim changes lifecycle state but is not proof of receipt, clearing, confirmation or closure.
Preserve the same PaymentIntent/operation identity.

operations.name: Confirm external/manual receipt
rules: Receiver owns manual receipt confirmation where ChopDot cannot independently verify.
Payer sent claim is not proof of receipt.

operations.name: Close PaymentIntent
rules: Close only from exact proven result.
Partial closes only confirmed partial amount; remainder stays open.
Resulting Position is recomputed, not manually overwritten.

operations.name: Reconcile PaymentIntent
rules: Unknown uses the same payment/operation identity.
No replacement execution until trusted no-effect truth.

operations.name: Create PaymentRequest
rules: Exact initiating balance/source scope.
Overlapping active-source request is reused; note changes do not create new debt.

operations.name: Deliver PaymentRequest
rules: Created, delivered and paid are distinct.
Delivery retry reuses the same request.

operations.name: Withdraw PaymentRequest
rules: Withdrawal preserves history/balance/membership and is blocked during payment.

operations.name: Create ReceivingShare
rules: Recipient-scoped and deliberate.
Share/copy/scan never confirms payment.
Unknown create reconciles before retry.

operations.name: Stop ReceivingShare
rules: Stopping a share is not payment/request cancellation and cannot recall already copied bytes.

operations.name: Contribute Savings
rules: No optimistic Available/goal progress.
Tracking mode requires confirmation.
Unknown result reconciles before retry.

operations.name: Withdraw Savings
rules: Own confirmed position by default.
Group-controlled withdrawal obeys configured group rule.
Unknown result reconciles before retry.

operations.name: Create / update PaymentDestination
rules: Method-specific validation and exact destination versioning.
No wallet/provider secrets.
Preference is compatibility-scoped, not authority.

operations.name: Remove PaymentDestination
rules: Removal is not payment cancellation.
Unknown result reconciles before retry.

operations.name: Connect / switch wallet context
rules: Connected account/network is revalidated at signing.
Connection does not create a saved receiving destination.

operations.name: Sign / submit WalletAction
rules: Owning journey defines exact action scope.
Signature, submission and finality remain distinct.
Unknown submission reconciles before retry.

operations.name: Resolve QR transport
rules: Transport is inert until the owning journey revalidates.
No direct join/payment/destination/wallet authority.

operations.name: Apply Import
rules: Preview before write.
One new group per import.
No existing-group auto-merge, name-only identity linking or silent money guessing.
Imported payment rows are history only.

operations.name: Create ExportArtifact
rules: Read-only preview until explicit Create export.
Bound to exact scope/snapshot/schema/destination intent.
Unknown generation reconciles before regeneration.

operations.name: Deliver ExportArtifact
rules: Package creation and external delivery are separate.
Unknown delivery reconciles destination status and never regenerates package by assumption.

operations.name: Create BackupArtifact
rules: Local working copy and backup are distinct.
Secrets/executable authority excluded.
Checksum claims byte integrity only.

operations.name: Restore from BackupArtifact
rules: Preview before restore mutation.
Preserve identity ambiguity and newer current facts.
Unknown outcomes reconcile before retry.

operations.name: Rename / archive / unarchive Group
rules: Rename changes display identity, not history/stable ID.
Archive is reversible organization state, not settlement/deletion/forgiveness.
Stale review refreshes before write.

operations.name: Transfer Group ownership
rules: Recipient is an eligible active member.
Roster management remains Journey 09.
Unknown result reconciles before retry.

operations.name: Leave Group
rules: Owner transfers ownership first.
Open/unresolved obligations block leave.
Historical attribution remains unchanged.

operations.name: Delete Group workspace
rules: Owner only, archived, sole active member, no open/unresolved items, typed confirmation and final review.
No claim of external/global erasure.

operations.name: Update profile / notification / appearance preference
rules: Draft/preview is not persisted preference.
UI preference is not external/system/payment authority.
Unknown writes reconcile before replacement retry.

operations.name: Sign out
rules: Sign-out changes session only; it does not delete account/group/money history.

operations.name: Delete account working state
rules: Blocked by active group ownership or unresolved money obligations.
Export is an adjacent owner boundary.
No global erasure claim for shared/provider/on-chain/backup copies.

operations.name: Authorize / execute SpendIntent
rules: Authorized does not mean spent.
Unknown cannot create/extend authority or dispatch fresh value.
Concrete rail remains replaceable/unselected.

operations.name: Materialize accepted SpendEffect
rules: Proof-backed accepted effect only.
Exactly-once canonical expense/obligation materialization.
Later PaymentIntent may settle but cannot recreate spend.

operations.name: Reconcile original operation
rules: Journey 28 coordinates recovery grammar; owning domain decides result.
Possible-effect states preserve exact identity.
Unknown/pending/partial does not expose replacement retry.

operations.name: Review safe retry
rules: Replacement retry only after proven no-effect truth.
Explicit stop preserves truth and enough context to resume safely.

operations.name: Set notification read state
rules: Read/unread is personal delivery metadata only.
Marking one or all notifications read never resolves the underlying domain item or AttentionItem.

operations.name: Withdraw Expense Issue
rules: Reviewer may withdraw their raised issue through Journey 07.
Withdrawal changes issue status; it does not edit the Expense or fabricate payment/settlement state.

dependent_state_effects.effect: invalidate any prepared intent whose eligibility depends on the changed dispute state; require fresh settlement resolution before execution

operations.name: Reply to Expense Issue
rules: Owner may reply through Journey 07 without editing the Expense.
A reply does not equal reviewer agreement or issue resolution; the reviewer can reassess with Looks right or Still off.

derived_models.name: HomeView
rules: Attention-first and group-first.
Offline/stale state labeled.

derived_models.name: GroupHomeView
rules: Overview-first current group state; navigation does not mutate underlying truth.
What needs you derives from AttentionItem.
Recent derives from GroupRecentItem rather than an independent fixture or the later J18 Activity screen.

derived_models.name: PositionView
rules: People default; same-currency netting only; mixed currencies separate; source lineage visible.

derived_models.name: SettlementHistoryView
rules: Read-only; one stable payment record per payment identity; states remain distinct.

derived_models.name: SavingsGroupView
rules: Goal progress from confirmed Available only; pending separate.

derived_models.name: ActivityView
rules: Read-only; attention and unread are independent; open rechecks current truth/access.

derived_models.name: InsightsView
rules: Read-only; current authorized scope only; exact assets separate; insufficient/incomplete evidence is labeled.

laws.name: Participant identity survives account linking
laws.rule: Link/upgrade preserves the same group-scoped participant_id and every historical expense/split/history/export/recovery reference.

laws.name: No name/email identity merge
laws.rule: Display name and email are never identity merge keys; collisions/mismatch remain unresolved.

laws.name: Group-scoped unlinkability
laws.rule: Group-visible identity must not expose a stable identifier that correlates an account-backed person across groups.

laws.name: Presentation/preferences are not authority
laws.rule: A saved preference, destination, notification or wallet connection does not itself create payment/signing/group/identity-provider authority.

laws.name: Exact partitioned money
laws.rule: Canonical financial conservation uses integer minor units with currency and exponent; cross-partition values never combine silently and display decimals are non-authoritative.

laws.name: Possible-effect identity is stable
laws.rule: Pending/unknown/partial/too-late cancellation states remain bound to the same operation identity until authoritative reconciliation.

laws.name: Unknown reconciles before replacement retry
laws.rule: A possible-effect unknown result cannot expose a replacement effect attempt until the original operation is proven no-effect.

laws.name: Navigation is not evidence
laws.rule: Back, reload, route changes or time alone never convert unknown/pending state into success, failure, cancellation or receipt.

laws.name: Stale truth refreshes before write
laws.rule: Stale/conflicting reviewed state refreshes current owner truth and requires re-review rather than overwriting it.

laws.name: Replay is side-effect free
laws.rule: Accepted history is append-only/replay-safe; replay rebuilds projections and never repeats external/payment/signing/receipt/closure effects.

laws.name: Expense split conserves amount
laws.rule: An explicit custom split must add to the Expense total within the exact money partition.

laws.name: Review and edit ownership stay separate
laws.rule: Journey 06 owns expense mutation; Journey 07 owns agreement/question/issue semantics. Owner correction does not fabricate reviewer agreement.

laws.name: Issues block only dependencies
laws.rule: An unresolved expense issue blocks only dependent payment items, not unrelated actionable balances.

laws.name: Position is derived and currency-separated
laws.rule: Position is a read model; mixed currencies remain separate and source group/item lineage stays explainable.

laws.name: Settlement scope is exact
laws.rule: Settlement binds one payer/recipient pair, one currency, exact amount and frozen eligible source lineage before authorization; later unrelated ledger changes do not silently widen that prepared scope.

laws.name: Payment lifecycle states are not collapsed
laws.rule: Sent/started/submitted/waiting/received/confirmed/closed and failure/unknown/partial/reversal states remain semantically distinct; provider/method may skip only in truthful ways.

laws.name: Partial closes exact confirmed amount
laws.rule: A partial payment closes only the confirmed portion; the remainder preserves source lineage and stays open.

laws.name: Request creation, delivery and payment are distinct
laws.rule: Accepted request creation does not imply delivery; delivery does not imply read/agreement/payment; only payment-domain proof may mark paid.

laws.name: Receiving disclosure is not receipt
laws.rule: Sharing/copying/stopping/expiry of receiving details never confirms payment or settlement.

laws.name: Wallet execution stays downstream of product authority
laws.rule: Owning ChopDot journey defines exact amount/asset/recipient/source/permission; wallet connect/sign/submit cannot widen it.

laws.name: QR is transport only
laws.rule: A QR payload is inert until owner-journey validation and cannot itself create membership, payment, destination or wallet authority.

laws.name: Savings uses confirmed money only
laws.rule: Planned/self-reported/submitted/waiting/unknown states do not increase confirmed Available or goal progress.

laws.name: Savings authority is explicit
laws.rule: Participant positions remain participant-owned by default; group-controlled withdrawal follows the configured rule and ChopDot never fabricates custody/confirmation.

laws.name: Activity and notification are projections
laws.rule: Activity is read-only; unread is not unresolved; notification delivery/read cannot mutate the underlying domain result.

laws.name: Insights are authorized derived patterns
laws.rule: Insights are read-only, current-access-scoped, like-for-like by currency/asset and do not double-count superseded/duplicate records.

laws.name: Import never guesses identity or money
laws.rule: Import previews before write, creates one new group, does not auto-merge existing groups, does not link people by name alone, and does not silently guess money semantics.

laws.name: Portable data is not executable authority
laws.rule: Export is read/copy-only; payment/wallet/receiving/imported records remain history/metadata and cannot become payment/share/sign/retry authority.

laws.name: Backup and working copy are distinct
laws.rule: Backup is distinct from local working copy; restore previews before mutation, preserves newer current facts/identity ambiguity, excludes secrets/executable authority, and reconciles unknown outcomes.

laws.name: Archive is not settlement or deletion
laws.rule: Archive is reversible organization state; it does not forgive/net/settle/delete balances or history.

laws.name: Access/lifecycle does not rewrite ledger truth
laws.rule: Removal, leave, transfer, rename, archive and delete prerequisites cannot silently rewrite expense attribution, balances, historical ledger facts or other memberships.

laws.name: Draft preference is not persisted preference
laws.rule: Profile/notification/appearance preview remains reversible until a verified save result.

laws.name: Account deletion respects adjacent authority
laws.rule: Deletion is blocked by group ownership or unresolved money obligations, routes to their owning journeys, and makes no global erasure claim.

laws.name: SpendIntent and PaymentIntent are separate economic domains
laws.rule: SpendIntent coordinates value before/during purchase; PaymentIntent settles an already-existing obligation. Settlement cannot recreate merchant spend.

laws.name: Authorized is not spent; effect materialization is exact once
laws.rule: Only proof-backed accepted effects materialize canonical financial state exactly once; unknown cannot dispatch fresh value or extend authority.

laws.name: Expense allocation preserves participant attribution
laws.rule: Every allocation entry is bound to a selected participant_id in the Expense's Group and carries MoneyV1 in the Expense partition. Correct total conservation never substitutes for correct per-participant attribution.

laws.name: Expense mutation obeys current settlement-related guard
laws.rule: For ordinary settlements, block Expense create/edit/delete when current or proposed state changes financial truth used by any unresolved settlement. Safe allow requires complete current/proposed evidence, a complete settlement descriptor, before/after dependency snapshots, and fresh authoritative reconciliation for any released scope.

active_scope.source: payment.intent + payment.settlement_scope + position.position + expense.issue + authoritative reconciliation
active_scope.condition: a settlement is unresolved unless it is in an allowed release state with authoritative reconciliation evidence at least as fresh as the evaluated state
active_scope.release: authoritative terminal/no-effect truth, fresh reconciliation evidence, and no open remainder referencing the dependency

laws.name: Accepted Expense mutations feed read-only change history
laws.rule: Important accepted Expense changes remain readable as old→new history derived from accepted prior/current revisions. History is read-only and storage-neutral.

laws.name: Stale Expense review must not remain current
laws.rule: Any Expense edit accepted by the Journey 06 Save changes path resets the reviews that were current at edit acceptance to `needs review again`, including a reviewer who the edit removes from the split. Review history remains readable. An open issue remains unresolved until Journey 07 records reviewer resolution.

constraint.open_issue_resolution: remains unresolved until Journey 07 reviewer action

laws.name: Whole-group closeout broadens expense mutation lock
laws.rule: When a separately approved whole-group closeout surface eventually creates an active GroupCloseoutContext, create/edit/delete for that Group are locked until the closeout is safely released. This is semantic-only and outside Gate B.

laws.name: Prepared settlement remains within current eligibility
laws.rule: A prepared or authorized settlement may not execute when current eligible balance or source eligibility has drifted from the resolved scope. The amount cannot exceed current eligible balance; dependency-changing Expense mutations are blocked, while a newly raised dispute invalidates the dependent prepared intent for re-resolution.

laws.name: Position scope is typed
laws.rule: Position scope is explicitly participant_pair or group. Settlement dependency/eligibility consumes participant_pair scope only; group scope remains a distinct read projection.

anti_collapse.reason: Group ledger identity survives account binding and remains group-scoped.
Settlement of existing obligation is not merchant spend before/during purchase.
Saved receiving destination is not signing/execution capability.
Request is a communication/collection object; it does not execute payment.
Unread delivery state is not unresolved domain work.
User-facing milestone projection is not raw accepted event/technical history.
Savings is intentionally a distinct economic/control model rather than an implicit expense-group mode.
Portable records/labels do not become executable guest authority.

known_gaps.detection: derive from frozen spec headers versus higher-authority registry/approval state
known_gaps.statement: Some frozen spec headers contain historical candidate/definition wording after higher-authority registry/approval records made the journey Golden.
known_gaps.handling: Do not hand-maintain a journey list. Verification derives drift at runtime; registry/approval controls status and frozen specs remain byte-unchanged.

known_gaps.statement: Concrete SpendIntent execution rail/provider remains unselected.
known_gaps.handling: Keep SpendIntent rail-neutral; do not invent provider semantics.

known_gaps.statement: Storage provider, backup format, sync/encryption/custody and deletion implementation details are not selected as product law.
known_gaps.handling: Preserve approved storage/recovery semantics without selecting infrastructure.

known_gaps.statement: Stage 3 composition exposed the missing semantic operation for notification read-state mutation.
known_gaps.handling: Added notification.set_read_state as a schema-only normalization of already-approved J18 behavior; no product source or runtime code changed.

resolved_authority_interpretations.rule: The recovered standalone J05 V1 candidate is the Gate B fidelity artifact because its exact 27-state / 98-link fingerprint and required paths match the frozen approved state inventory and visual-QA record.
A successful persisted Expense change resets current prior reviews to needs-review-again while preserving review history; owner correction does not resolve an issue without reviewer action in J07.

resolved_product_decisions.rule: Dependency-scoped settlement locking was approved; the economic-dependency interpretation and Gate B Golden impact are defined by DEC-EXPENSE-SETTLEMENT-LOCK-02.

Gate B ordinary settlement locking evaluates current and proposed economic dependency and fails closed on unresolved settlement truth. Whole-group closeout remains a future semantic-only mode outside Gate B.

golden_impacts.rule: J05 locked remains a Gate B recovery state when a proposed Expense mutation would change an unresolved settlement dependency. Its historical blanket copy ('Expenses are locked. Settlement is in progress.') is superseded for ordinary settlements; the Gate B blocked state must identify the blocking settlement/dependency while preserving entered details.
The historical blanket-unavailable Add Expense state is superseded for ordinary settlements and is not a Gate B required state. Revisit it when a dedicated whole-group closeout surface is approved.

executable_reference_contracts.role: executable reference for the machine-readable Expense mutation guard contract
